completion_criteria.rule: This is a draft-only simulation: sending vendor or customer messages is outside its scope and is never required to complete the internal workflow. A ticket is resolved for internal processing when the Boss, through the agent and MCP workflow, confirms that every payment it needs is paid, every vendor draft it needs is complete, the latest customer draft accurately describes the situation, and no decision is open. The Boss's note then states that the drafts remain unsent and that no order, shipment or delivery is confirmed. Resolution never requires sending, delivery, stock arriving or a customer's acceptance, and it never means the customer's order was fulfilled.
completion_criteria.source: The owner's clarification, relayed to the Boss word for word as the operator note of run 20261014-080030-3a7c0a (audit record 149), and written into the Boss's prompt (backend/prompts/boss.md, "When a ticket is complete") before that run.

earlier_rule.rule: A ticket is resolved when the shop's own work on it is complete, as the Boss judges it through the agent and MCP workflow. Resolution never requires physical delivery or a customer's acceptance, and the agents never send anything. Nothing that is still internal work may be skipped by marking a ticket resolved.
earlier_rule.source: The owner's instruction for finishing Problem 9, relayed to the Boss word for word in the notes of the completion pass (audit records 132 and 144).
earlier_rule.superseded_because: Under it, and under the Boss's prompt at the time, the Boss counted sending the vendor order (draft #3) as internal work still to do, and kept ticket 101 waiting_on_vendor (update #7). The owner then clarified that sending is outside the scope of this draft-only simulation.

per_ticket.101: Internal work: pay the blocking invoice with a person's approval (done: payment #1), prepare a complete reprint request (done: draft #3), and prepare an accurate customer update (done: draft #4, replacing the out-of-date draft #1). The Boss verified all three itself and found no open decision, so it resolved the ticket for internal processing (update #9). Sending the drafts is outside this simulation. Nothing was ordered, shipped or delivered, and the customer's order has not been fulfilled.
per_ticket.102: Internal work: pay the rent once, with a person's approval, before it is due (done: payment #2). No drafts are needed. Resolved (update #6).
per_ticket.103: Internal work: decide the request (the owner declined the 20 that can't be supplied), record the disposition, and keep the approved alternative as an accurate unsent draft (draft #2). No payment or vendor draft is needed and no decision is open. Resolved (update #8). Sending the alternative offer is optional, and a sale would be new work.

completion_criteria.tickets_not_rerun: Tickets 102 and 103 were not rerun after the clarification. Their recorded outcomes (updates #6 and #8) already fit it: 102 needed only the paid rent, and 103's disposition left no decision open, with draft #2 an accurate unsent alternative.
